name: Triassic Park Steinplatte
kurzbeschreibung: Triassic Park on the 1,700 m high Steinplatte in Waidring: prehistoric petrified coral sea, dinosaur models, Triassic Beach, and stalactite cave.
beschreibung:
Overview

The spectacular Triassic Park is located at nearly 1,700 meters above sea level on the sunny high plateau of the Steinplatte in the municipality of Waidring in Tyrol's Pillerseetal (district of Kitzbühel). Where majestic limestone cliffs now soar into the sky, the subtropical primeval Tethys Ocean stretched some 200 million years ago. The Steinplatte is the only preserved fossil dry reef from the Triassic period in Europe. Opened in 2008, this ultra-modern nature, leisure, and educational park combines fascinating Earth history and paleontology with an action-packed alpine mountain experience for families, nature enthusiasts, and hikers against the scenic backdrop of the Loferer Steinberge.

Primeval Sea & Attractions

The journey back to prehistoric times begins right at the mountain gondola station: in the sheltered, all-weather Triassic Center, interactive discovery stations, multimedia reef aquariums, genuine fossils, and a submarine simulator illustrate how life originated in the prehistoric ocean. In the expansive outdoor area, the four-kilometer-long Triassic Trail leads past life-sized models of dinosaurs and primeval marine reptiles such as the ichthyosaur. An architectural highlight for the brave is the cantilevered Steinplatte viewing platform: shaped like a monumental fan coral, the glass-and-steel construction juts roughly 70 meters out over the sheer vertical rock precipice, offering dizzying downward views and a panoramic vista stretching to Lake Chiemsee and the Großglockner. At Triassic Beach – an artificially created mountain lake at 1,700 m with a sandy beach, mini rafts, and water features – young explorers can use hammers to uncover genuine fossils in the designated dig site. The park is rounded out by a walk-through stalactite cave with light and sound installations.

Visit & Getting There

Triassic Park Steinplatte is open during the snow-free summer months from mid-May to early November, daily from 09:00 to 16:45. Admission to Triassic Park, the Triassic Center, and the viewing platform is free – visitors only require a cable car ticket. Gondola ticket prices for ascent and descent (as of the 2025/2026 season): adults approx. €27.00, youth approx. €20.50, children (birth years 2009–2018) approx. €14.00; toddlers ride free. Holders of the regional PillerseeTal Card or Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card ride the gondola free of charge. Arriving by gondola: The modern 8-seater Steinplatte gondola starts directly on the outskirts of Waidring and transports visitors to the top station in about ten minutes. By car: Via the B178 to Waidring to the large free parking lot at the gondola valley station. By public transit: ÖBB train to St. Johann in Tirol station, then by bus line 4012 directly to the Waidring Steinplatte Gondelbahn stop.

Tips

The gondola lift, Triassic Center, the circular path around Triassic Beach, and the spectacular viewing platform are barrier-free and easily accessible with strollers and all-terrain wheelchairs. Bring swimwear and towels for children, as the sand and water playground at Triassic Beach provides wonderful refreshment on hot summer days. The panorama restaurant at the mountain station serves traditional Tyrolean dumpling specialties.
